title: fix(auth)!: a server outside development mode refuses a development seed credential
body:
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不在开发模式（`NODE_ENV` 不是 `development`）的服务器不再接受开发种子凭据：用开发种子密码（`admin123`，或 `OS_SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` 的值）登录一律拒绝；`os dev` 种出的管理员和 `demoStaff` 账号带上种子标记，只要密码还是种子时的那个，任何登录方式都不给开会话。新增 `os user set-password EMAIL`，在服务器上直接改密码，拒绝提示里点名它。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决（选项 A，经两轮契约档审查修订）：不在开发模式的服务器永不接受开发种子凭据；拒绝放在 plugin-auth，`os start`、`os serve`、镜像与自定义宿主一并覆盖。
- 风险与回滚：生产模式下凡是密码等于开发种子密码的账号都登不进去，需运维用新命令改密；开发模式完全不变。每次建会话在生产模式多一次 `sys_user` 读，密码校验成功时多一次按索引的读。回滚即 revert 本 PR（新列留空无害）。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/dev-seed-credential.ts`（三条拒绝与种子标记，留意 `withDevSeedPasswordRefusal` 与 `refuseDevSeedCredentialSession`）、`auth-manager-database-hooks.ts` 与 `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts` 的接线、`packages/cli/src/commands/user/set-password.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/dev-seed-credential-production.test.ts`，应见 10 个用例全绿（开发模式对照组 + 生产模式拒绝 + 改密后可登录）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（a security item is with the owner seat）。

## What changes

**The rule: a server that is not in development mode never accepts a development seed credential.** Development mode is `NODE_ENV=development`, the clause the development seed itself is gated on. The rule lives in `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, so `os start`, `os serve`, the image and a custom host all apply it.

- **The seed password is refused at sign-in, on any account** (`refuseDevSeedPasswordSignIn`, first in the global `hooks.before`). A password sign-in (`/sign-in/email`, `/sign-in/username`, `/sign-in/phone-number`) that submits the development seed password — `admin123`, or the value `OS_SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` sets — answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with a sentence naming `os user set-password EMAIL`. It is decided on the submitted password alone, before any account is read: every address gets the same answer, so it says nothing about any account. This covers the seeded admin, the demo staff, any other account on that password, and databases seeded before the stamp below existed.
- **The verifier never accepts a seed credential** (`withDevSeedPasswordRefusal`, wrapping the pair handed to `emailAndPassword.password`). After the real verification runs in full, a match is answered "no match" for a seed password, and for the hash a stamped account still holds from the seed. Every door that checks a password then answers exactly what a wrong password answers, so a correct custom seed password is never confirmed to a caller.
- **The seed stamp.** `sys_user.dev_seed_credential` (new, `internal`, `readonly`, indexed, translated in all locales) holds a SHA-256 digest of the password hash the seed stored, never the password. It is staged by the audience gate for an operator-class creation (the class only the seed's provisioning ticket earns) and written in `account.create.after` when that creation's password credential lands, in development only. "Still on the seed password" is "the stored hash still has this digest", so a custom `os dev --admin-password` / `OS_SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` is caught without the server ever knowing it, and any password change stops the stamp matching.
- **A stamped account still on its seed password opens no session** (`refuseDevSeedCredentialSession`, in `session.create.before` beside the locked-account and service-account refusals): password, emailed link, one-time code, passkey, social or SSO, impersonation and a minted session all go through it. The answer is `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` naming the reset command; a read that fails answers `503`, as the sibling refusals do.
- **No forced change at sign-in.** No refusal opens a session in which the password could be changed.
- **`os user set-password EMAIL`** (new `user` topic). Boots the identity objects for their declarations only, resolves the account first (an unknown address is refused before any password is asked for), reads the password from an unechoed prompt (twice) or `--password-stdin`, never from argv. plugin-auth's new `setOperatorPassword` refuses a seed password and a length outside 8 to 128, refuses an account with no password credential, writes better-auth's own hash, clears the stamp and any sign-in lock, stamps `password_changed_at`, and ends every session and revokes every API key of the account (`revokeSessionsAndApiKeys`, `admin_password_reset`). It sets no forced change.
- Docs: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (the command), `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` (the rule).

**The refusal's answer, chosen.** The seed password itself is answered with the typed refusal naming the command: it is decided before any account is read, so naming the remedy discloses nothing. A stamped account on a custom seed password is answered as a wrong password on the password doors: that refusal comes after the credential check, and a typed answer there would confirm a correct password. The server logs that refusal at `warn` with the account id and the command.

## Tests

- `dev-seed-credential-production.test.ts` (10, real `ObjectKernel` + ObjectQL on SQLite + real `AuthPlugin` with one `demoStaff` entry + `SecurityPlugin`, seeded in development, then served by a second `AuthManager` outside development):
  development control (both accounts sign in, both stamped); the stamp is a digest and never served on reads; the seed admin refused 403 with the command and no session; a demo account refused; an unknown address answered identically; an unstamped account on the seed password refused; a stamped account on a custom seed password answered exactly as a wrong password with no session; the emailed sign-in link opens no session for it (403 with the command); after `setOperatorPassword` the new password signs in, the stamp is gone and the development session is ended; the reset's refusals write nothing.
- `dev-seed-credential.test.ts` (7, unit): the seed password set, the pre-lookup refusal's doors and development passthrough, the verifier's four answers.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/user/set-password.integration.test.ts` (3, real SQLite file through oclif): sets the password from stdin in the format a server verifies and ends the session and the API key; refuses the seed password and writes nothing; refuses an unknown address before asking.
- `schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration.test.ts`: the command joins the one-shot family (its write mode runs no seed write and mints no key material).

## Acceptance notes

- This PR edits none of the plugin-auth files open PR #34333 held (merged since). `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts` carries three small hunks (an import, the verifier wrap, one line in `hooks.before`) and merged cleanly with #34617.
- A database seeded before this release with a custom seed password carries no stamp and is not detected; the changeset states it at rule level.
- A refused seed-password sign-in runs before the lockout gate, so it neither counts toward a lock nor writes a `login_failed` audit row.

The two commits after it (`f3eb2cf0e7`, `2ba2eb95d0`: a warn fallback on the stamp's log sink, module-top preloads in the CLI suite, the tenant audit census counts, and the dogfood fixture below) were re-checked as listed.

Each mutation was red, then restored, with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. Control: 10 of 10.
